SELECT S.STORE_NO AS storeNo, S.STORE_NAME AS storeName, S.S_STATUS AS sStatus, S.S_ADDR AS addr, SD.SUB_TITLE AS subTitle, SD.S_CONTENTS AS contents, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SM.MENU_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS menuNames, MIN(SM.MENU_PRICE) AS minPrice, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(R.RATING), 1), 0) AS avgRating, COUNT(DISTINCT R.REVIEW_NO) AS reviewCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT R.R_CONTENTS SEPARATOR ' / ') AS reviewContents FROM STORE S LEFT JOIN STORE_DETAIL SD ON S.STORE_NO = SD.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN STORE_MENU SM ON S.STORE_NO = SM.STORE_NO AND SM.M_STATUS = 'Y' LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON S.STORE_NO = R.STORE_NO WHERE S.S_STATUS IN ('GEN', 'AFF') AND S.IS_OPEN = 'Y'
AND ( S.STORE_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR S.S_ADDR LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(SD.SUB_TITLE, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(SD.S_CONTENTS, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR SM.MENU_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR IFNULL(SM.MENU_INFO, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR R.R_CONTENTS LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY S.STORE_NO, S.STORE_NAME, S.S_ADDR, SD.SUB_TITLE, SD.S_CONTENTS
ORDER BY reviewCount DESC, avgRating DESC, minPrice ASC
LIMIT 10
